name: Middle Way Mathematics • CRUD Studio Affordance Model
description: Authoritative semantic mental model of the MWM CRUD Studio UI. Maps state dimensions, UI selectors, input event handlers, backend database behaviors, and output semantics to enable human and autonomous agent task execution.

modes.read: Authoritative inspection of an existing database entity record and its relational graph.
modes.update: Parameterized SQL mutation of an existing entity record with dirty tracking and foreign key assignment.
modes.create: Instantiation and persistence of a new entity record with schema-informed defaults.

delete.description: Safeguarded entity deletion governed by two distinct relational policies.

policies.restricted_guard: Zero-Dependents Policy: Enforces that the entity has all empty 1:m relationships. If references exist in segment_references or FK tables, deletion is inhibited and referencing parents are displayed. No automatic attempt is made to delete children. (Applies to TTD/demos, formal statements, directed equations, pseudocode algorithms).
policies.cascading_verified: Impact Analysis & Dry Run Policy: Computes the structural blast radius across navigation items, segments, and junction tables. Displays an impact inventory modal and executes atomic cascading deletion only after positive user verification. (Applies to leaf index entries and curriculum segments).

db_health_badge.semantics: Live verification of PostgreSQL database connection pool status on port 5432.

sql_console_link.behavior: Navigates to the Interactive Database SQL Console.

reader_app_link.behavior: Opens the Middle Way Mathematics curriculum reader in a new browser tab.

btn_ops_backup.behavior: Executes pg_dump on PostgreSQL database 'hobbynotes', writes canonical db/backups/latest.sql, and saves a timestamped snapshot.
btn_ops_backup.output_semantics: Freezes complete PostgreSQL schema and data state into git-tracked files.

btn_ops_prep.behavior: Runs database snapshot, verifies Lean 4 cache, extracts all 57 segments from PostgreSQL, and regenerates app1/dist/index.html.
btn_ops_prep.output_semantics: Static distribution bundle is fresh; reader is ready for a browser hard-refresh.

btn_ops_deploy.behavior: Presents deployment confirmation modal; upon confirmation, triggers POST /api/ops/deploy to stage git changes, commit, and push to origin master.
btn_ops_deploy.output_semantics: Publishes latest curriculum and database state live to middlewaymath.app.

mode_dropdown.behavior: Sets active CRUD mode, closes dropdown, updates breadcrumbs, and renders appropriate view.

type_dropdown.behavior: Selects active entity type; refreshes instance list and renders entity cards.

subject_dropdown.behavior: Filters available instances across disciplinary subject domains.

btn_reset_studio.behavior: Clears navigation history, resets mode to Read, subject to All, and returns to landing state.

instance_selector.behavior: Queries PostgreSQL for chosen instance ID and renders full Attribute-Complete card.

fk_navigation_arrow.behavior: Smoothly transitions studio context to inspect the referenced child or parent record (pushes current view to nav history).

open_content_editor_button.behavior: Opens the Segment Content Authoring Surface in Read (inspection) mode.

fk_picker_button.behavior: Opens modal listing all valid candidate child records; selecting one updates the hidden foreign key field and displays its friendly key badge.

fk_nav_button.behavior: Pushes current edit form state and navigates directly to inspect the currently referenced child record.

open_authoring_surface_button.behavior: Opens the Segment Content Authoring Surface in Update (authoring) mode.

btn_submit_record.behavior: Validates inputs, executes parameterized SQL (INSERT if isNew else UPDATE) via /api/sql, rebuilds catalogs in background, and switches to Read inspection of the saved entity.
btn_submit_record.output_semantics: Record is permanently persisted to PostgreSQL.

btn_cancel_record.behavior: Discards unsaved form changes and returns to Read inspection or instance selection menu.

btn_back_to_record.behavior: Confirms if dirty; returns to entity form or attribute card with updated content_html synced.

editorial_status_select.behavior: Updates target segment's status column value in PostgreSQL upon save.

insert_ttd.label: ⚖️ Truth Table (<ttd-ref>)
insert_ttd.behavior: Queries database for truth table propositions, embeds canonical <ttd-ref> tag at cursor, renders live chip.

insert_fs.label: 📜 Formal Statement (<fs-ref>)
insert_fs.behavior: Embeds formal statement citation chip linking to Lean 4 kernel theorems.

insert_demo.label: 🎨 Interactive Visual Demo (<visual-demo>)
insert_demo.behavior: Embeds dynamic visual simulation or canvas widget.

insert_pseudo.label: ⚡ Pseudocode Algorithm (<pseudo-ref>)
insert_pseudo.behavior: Embeds discrete algorithm box with syntax-highlighted routine.

btn_save_db.behavior: Synchronizes WYSIWYG/Source panes, sanitizes MathJax/chip decorations, and executes direct parameterized SQL: 'UPDATE segments SET content_html = $1, status = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3;'.
btn_save_db.output_semantics: Directly replaces the segment's content_html in PostgreSQL and updates saveStatusPill to '✓ Saved'.

states.ready: ✓ Ready — Editor loaded with authoritative database content.
states.modified: ● Modified — Content has been altered in editor panes and is pending database save.
states.saving: Saving... — Asynchronous SQL query executing against PostgreSQL bridge.
states.saved: ✓ Saved — Successfully written to PostgreSQL segments table.

btn_toggle_mode.behavior: Toggles between Read mode (inspection) and Edit mode (authoring toolbar active).

custom_ref_chips.behavior: Opens the Authoritative Entity Inspector modal for the clicked custom element tag without navigating away from the segment.

btn_delete_record.behavior: Inspects active entity type's delete_policy: triggers #modal-restricted-guard if 'restricted_guard', or #modal-cascade-impact if 'cascading_verified'.

restricted_guard_modal.behavior: Queries PostgreSQL segment_references and foreign keys. If dependent count > 0, renders warning banner, lists referencing segments with jump links, and disables confirmation. Makes zero effort to automatically delete dependents.
restricted_guard_modal.preflight_query: SELECT sr.id, s.seg_key, s.title, sr.raw_tag FROM segment_references sr JOIN segments s ON s.id = sr.segment_id WHERE sr.demo_id = $1;
restricted_guard_modal.output_semantics: Protects reusable assets by inhibiting deletion until all referencing 1:m relationships are cleared by the author.

cascade_impact_modal.behavior: Computes impact inventory (child nav items, bound segment, join links, prerequisite bindings). Displays color-coded impact summary and requires verified user confirmation.
cascade_impact_modal.preflight_query: SELECT n.id, n.topic, s.id as segment_id, s.seg_key, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.id) as ref_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id) as prereq_count FROM curriculum_nav_items n LEFT JOIN segments s ON s.id = n.segment_id LEFT JOIN segment_references sr ON sr.segment_id = s.id LEFT JOIN segment_prerequisites sp ON sp.segment_id = s.id WHERE n.id = $1 GROUP BY n.id, n.topic, s.id, s.seg_key;
cascade_impact_modal.output_semantics: Provides complete transparency of relational blast radius prior to destructive execution.

btn_confirm_cascade_delete.behavior: Executes atomic transaction in PostgreSQL: deletes junction rows, navigation item, and associated segment; triggers catalog and index rebuild in background.
btn_confirm_cascade_delete.output_semantics: Removes leaf navigation item and bound segment cleanly from PostgreSQL without leaving orphaned relational records.

output_semantics.toast_saved_content_html: Confirms PostgreSQL has updated the content_html text column for the active segment row.
output_semantics.toast_prep_complete: Confirms database dump completed to db/backups/latest.sql and all 54 segments were recompiled into app1/dist/index.html.
output_semantics.toast_deployed: Confirms git commit created and pushed to origin master; remote server has received changes for middlewaymath.app.
output_semantics.toast_deleted_restricted: Confirms entity record deleted after verifying zero referencing dependents exist.
output_semantics.toast_deleted_cascaded: Confirms leaf index entry and associated segment transactionally removed from PostgreSQL.

create_and_link_truth_table.ui: Click #type-btn -> Select 'Truth Table Demo (TTD)' under Interactive Demos

create_and_link_truth_table.result: Creates row in interactive_demos with a unique ID.

create_and_link_truth_table.ui: Switch Mode to 'Update', Type to 'Segments', and select target segment.
Click .btn-open-authoring-surface ('✏️ Open in Full Authoring Surface')
Click cursor in text -> Click '⨁ Insert Element' -> '⚖️ Truth Table (<ttd-ref>)' -> Choose the proposition -> Click 'Insert <ttd-ref>'

create_and_link_truth_table.result: Executes UPDATE segments SET content_html = $1 WHERE id = $2

create_and_link_directed_equation.ui: Mode: Create, Type: Directed Equations (Stencils). Provide equation_key, title, formula, variable slots.
Open Segment Content Editor, click '⨁ Insert Element' -> '📐 Computational Stencil (<interactive-stencil>)', select the equation key, and save.

delete_ttd_restricted_flow.ui: Click #type-btn -> Select 'Truth Table Demo (TTD)' under Interactive Demos

delete_ttd_restricted_flow.sql: SELECT sr.id, s.seg_key, s.title FROM segment_references sr JOIN segments s ON s.id = sr.segment_id WHERE sr.demo_id = $1;

result_branch.has_dependents: Modal #modal-restricted-guard lists referencing segments (e.g. 'propLogicLecture'). Deletion button is disabled. Author must first edit the segment to remove the reference.
result_branch.zero_dependents: Confirms zero dependencies; enables single-record deletion; executes 'DELETE FROM interactive_demos WHERE id = $1;'.

delete_leaf_index_entry_cascading_flow.ui: Select leaf navigation item bound to a segment (e.g. #85 'Proposal 1: Open Educational Service Hubs')

impact_inventory.dependent_joins: Associated segment_references, formal_statement_segments, and demo links

delete_leaf_index_entry_cascading_flow.sql_transaction: BEGIN; DELETE FROM segment_references WHERE segment_id = $1; DELETE FROM curriculum_nav_items WHERE id = $2; DELETE FROM segments WHERE id = $1; COMMIT;

delete_leaf_index_entry_cascading_flow.ui: CRUD Studio executes background catalog sync and transitions view to adjacent navigation sibling.
